Hello World Test page

sequenceDiagram

posts/ocr-evolution.title: The Evolution of Open Source OCR Tools
posts/ocr-evolution.content:
The Evolution of Open Source OCR Tools
Optical Character Recognition (OCR) has shifted drastically away from rigid layout engines toward robust deep-learning architectures.
When conducting side research into text extraction pipelines, managing code repositories alongside personal documentation becomes highly vital.
For instance, you can reference the project breakdown stored inside my private collection at paddleocr-pipeline.
